title.narrative: Improving Access to Quality and Inclusive Education with Gender Equality for Out of School Children in Babil and Baghdad Governorates, Iraq
MIGLIORARE L'ACCESSO AD UN 'EDUCAZIONE INCLUSIVA E DI QUALITÀ PER I BAMBINI CHE SONO FUORI DALL’AMBITO SCOLASTICO, in IRAQ

description.narrative: Building upon the on-going project “AID 11931 - Improving Access to Quality and Inclusive Education with Gender Equality for Out of School Children in Salah Al Din and Baghdad, Iraq”, funded by the Education Above All Foundation of Qatar. The proposed action further aims to provide 10,000 Out of School Children (OSC) in Babil and Baghdad governorates with learningopportunities, safer and more conducive learning environment and enhanced quality of education. Based on the continuing successful implementation of the second phase of Educate A Child Initiative (EACI)’s project “Improving Access to Quality and Inclusive Education with Gender Equality for Out of School Children in Iraq”, which aims to reach the total number of 150,000 OSC in the six targeted governorates of Iraq, including the 17,000 OSC in Salah Al Din and Baghdad from the Italian contribution. Additional 10,000 OSC in Baghdad
